# Dicecodes AI Blog Writer

> Set up Dicecodes AI Blog Writer for WordPress. Bring your own API key, or write straight from Claude or ChatGPT over MCP. Every feature free, no subscription.

A free WordPress plugin that writes blog posts. It researches the subject
first, writes to a voice you describe, scores every draft against
twenty-five checks, and rewrites what fails before anything is published.

Two ways to run it:

- **With your own API key.** OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq,
  Mistral, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, xAI and others. Billed to you by that
  provider. This is the way that can write on a schedule.
- **From Claude or ChatGPT.** The app connects to the site over the Model
  Context Protocol and does the writing on the subscription you already
  pay for. No API key and no second bill.

A model can also run on your own machine with Ollama, LM Studio, Jan or
llama.cpp, in which case nothing is sent to anyone.

Every feature is included. There is no paid tier, no trial, no credits
and no quota. The plugin has no server of its own, collects no analytics
and sends nothing to its author.

## Documentation

- [Start here](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#quickstart): Five steps, about ten minutes. Nothing is contacted until you finish the first one.
- [Connecting a provider](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#providers): Dicecodes AI Blog Writer has no AI of its own. It uses your account, and your provider bills you directly.
- [Writing from Claude or ChatGPT](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#clients): Use the subscription you already pay for. No API key, and usually no token either.
- [Describing your voice](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#voice): Sent with every request. The reason two blogs on the same model do not read alike.
- [How it writes](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#how-it-writes): The standing brief every post is written to.
- [Writing a post](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#writing-a-post): One required field. Everything else already has an answer.
- [Research](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#research): The biggest single lever on whether a post is worth reading.
- [Pictures](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#pictures): The article decides what a picture shows. These controls decide how it looks.
- [What is checked](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#what-is-checked): Every draft is measured before it becomes a post, and each failure is written back into the rewrite as an instruction.
- [Where posts go](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#where-posts-go): A finished post is a normal WordPress post.
- [Automation](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#automation): Not needed to write a post by hand. Switch it on once the writing already looks right to you.
- [Checking it works](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#checking-it-works): The test on the settings screen sends one short request and reports exactly what came back.
- [What leaves your site](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#privacy): Dicecodes AI Blog Writer contacts no servers of its own and sends nothing to the plugin author.
- [Looking for an alternative?](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#alternatives): Most AI writing plugins work one of two ways: you buy credits, or you pay a monthly subscription.
- [If you delete this plugin](https://dicecodes.com/ai-blog-writer/#removal): Deleting Dicecodes AI Blog Writer leaves your settings, your writing rules and your posts exactly where they are.

## Elsewhere

- [Plugin directory listing](https://wordpress.org/plugins/dicecodes-ai-blog-writer/): install it from here.
- [Download](https://downloads.wordpress.org/plugin/dicecodes-ai-blog-writer.zip): the current release, version 1.3.3.
